name: Supabase
description: Supabase is an open source Firebase alternative that provides a complete backend platform built on Postgres, letting developers build in a weekend and scale to millions of users.
best_for: Developers building web and mobile applications who want a self-hostable, open source backend with a real Postgres database and no vendor lock-in.
features: Dedicated Postgres database with auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs
Authentication with 20+ social login providers, email, phone/OTP, and magic links
Row Level Security policies enforced directly in Postgres
S3-compatible Storage with image transformations, served across 285+ cities
Edge Functions: distributed TypeScript/Deno serverless functions
Realtime: WebSocket-based database change listeners, presence, and broadcast
Vector toolkit using pgvector for AI embedding storage and search
SOC2 Type 2 compliance with availability across 16+ global regions

alternatives.name: Firebase
alternatives.description: Google's app development platform providing a NoSQL database, authentication, hosting, and serverless functions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams building mobile-first apps who want deep Google Cloud integration.

alternatives.name: Render
alternatives.description: A cloud platform for deploying web services, background workers, cron jobs, static sites, and databases.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want simple, managed cloud infrastructure without deep DevOps overhead.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to two active projects, 50,000 monthly active users, 500 MB database size, 5 GB egress, 5 GB cached egress, and 1 GB file storage. Free projects pause after one week of inactivity.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Includes the first project and $10/month in compute credits; 100,000 monthly active users, 8 GB disk, 250 GB egress, 100 GB file storage, seven-day daily-backup retention, and usage overages.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Adds dashboard SSO, project-scoped/read-only access, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, priority support/SLAs, 14-day backup retention, and 28-day log retention.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing with designated support, uptime SLAs, AWS PrivateLink, 24/7 premium support, and custom security questionnaires.

pros: The free plan includes a Postgres database, authentication, storage, and up to two active projects rather than only a time-limited trial
Pro has a published $25/month starting price and includes $10/month in compute credits
The pricing page publishes included quotas and overage rates for users, database size, egress, and file storage
cons: Free projects are paused after one week of inactivity and the account is limited to two active projects
Pro can incur separate overages for monthly active users, database size, egress, cached egress, storage, compute, and optional log drains
Team starts at $599/month, a large jump for teams that need dashboard SSO, longer retention, or organization-level compliance controls

faq.question: Is Supabase free?
faq.answer: Yes. The Free plan includes two active projects, 50,000 monthly active users, a 500 MB database, 5 GB egress, and 1 GB file storage. Free projects pause after one week of inactivity.

faq.question: How much does Supabase Pro cost?
faq.answer: Pro starts at $25/month. The first project is included, paid plans include $10/month in compute credits, and usage beyond included quotas is billed separately.

faq.question: What can increase a Supabase bill beyond the plan price?
faq.answer: The official pricing page lists overages or add-ons for monthly active users, database disk, egress, cached egress, file storage, compute, additional projects, and log drains.
